answer_2.quote: We analyze annotation performance using Cohen's kappa, F1 score, recall, and precision.

answer_4.quote: We recruited human annotators through Connect. ... Annotators were presented with the original screenshots of posts provided by authors and asked to identify emotions expressed by the author...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to follow three guidelines: (1) they could select multiple emotions, but only those they were reasonably confident were expressed; (2) if no emotions were expressed, they were to select "Neutral"; and (3) if they could not confidently assign any label from the list, they were to select "Unrecognizable".
